description: VÅRDTRÄD self-watering plant pot, indoor/outdoor transparent/anthracite, 3 ½" Forgetting to water is human. With VÅRDTRÄD self-watering plant pot, your plants will still forgive you – great when you're away or have other things on your mind than watering. And it looks nice too!
features: The wick at the bottom soaks up the water and keeps the soil or inner pot moist.
When you plant with an inner pot, put one layer of clay pebbles underneath the wick to ensure that the soil and the water are in contact with each other.
The wick is a spare part that can be ordered and replaced.
The plant pot is comprised of a minimum of 20% recycled plastic, and the saucer is comprised of a minimum of 50% recycled plastic.
For indoor and outdoor use at temperatures above 32°F.
materialAndCare: Plant pot: Polypropylene plastic (min. 20% recycled); Saucer: Polypropylene plastic (min. 50% recycled); Wick: 88 % polyester, 12 % nylon
